items.title: first-move-unexplained
items.claim: Image #2 explains HasanAbi’s tactic and labels the sticks STANCE and TECHNIQUE, but does not explain the stance-plus-technique combination described in Image #6.
items.reason: A new player sees FIGHT before receiving the instruction needed to perform a deliberate move.
items.suggest: Add “Hold a stance, then add a technique” directly above FIGHT, using the same terminology as the technique reference.

items.title: separated-direction-labels
items.claim: Image #3 places direction-to-action mappings in a separate panel above the sticks, while the corresponding stick edges show only chevrons.
items.reason: Players must visually connect each legend entry to a different location while learning the controls.
items.suggest: Place each action label beside its corresponding stick direction, keeping the drag areas unobstructed and all labels at least 18 CSS px.

items.title: rematch-only-choice
items.claim: Image #18 shows REMATCH and STARTING IN 8, but no visible control for declining another bout or ending the session.
items.reason: The result screen presents replay as the only explicit choice.
items.suggest: Add an “End session” button alongside REMATCH that cancels the pending start and returns to the pre-fight screen.

items.title: settings-pause-unidentified
items.claim: Image #7 shows settings over the visible arena without a PAUSED indicator, and the still cannot establish whether the bout is suspended.
items.reason: Players need to know whether they can safely adjust settings without the opponent continuing to fight.
items.suggest: Check simulation ticks and the round timer while settings are open; if suspended, show “Bout paused,” and if not, implement suspension before displaying that label.

items.title: control-font-size-unverified
items.claim: The action labels in Image #3 are visible, but their compliance with the 18 CSS px minimum cannot be determined from this screenshot alone.
items.reason: These labels carry essential instructions, and screenshot dimensions are not computed CSS font measurements.
items.suggest: Measure the labels’ computed font sizes at 390×844 and desktop widths; increase any below 18 CSS px and adjust wrapping or spacing rather than shrinking text.
